text: What architectural change did NAT make to the Internet, as a side effect?
choices: It converted a network of peers into a network of clients and servers, since ordinary users can consume services but not offer them
explanation: There is no translation entry until an internal host creates one, so unsolicited inbound packets have nowhere to go. Port forwarding, STUN, TURN, ICE and every video-calling application's NAT traversal machinery exist because of this.
